clause_text: Borrowers shall pay their EMIs into a collection account held by the LSP, which shall pool the repayments and pass them on to the Company's bank account every week.

draft.label: conflict
draft.rationale: Repayments are routed through a pooled LSP account; the rule requires repayment directly into the NBFC's bank account without any pass-through or pool account.
draft.citation_quote: without any pass-through account/ pool account of any third party

clause_text: The Company shall invoke any default loss guarantee within a maximum overdue period of 90 days, unless the borrower makes good the loan dues before that.

draft.label: compliant
draft.rationale: Invoking the DLG within 90 days overdue is within the maximum overdue period the rule sets.
draft.citation_quote: An NBFC shall invoke DLG within a maximum overdue period of 90 days, unless the loan dues are made good by the borrower before that.

clause_text: An LSP may provide default loss guarantee cover of up to ten per cent of the total amount disbursed out of the loan portfolio it sources for the Company.

draft.label: conflict
draft.rationale: DLG cover of ten per cent exceeds the cap the rule sets on the amount disbursed out of the portfolio.

clause_text: To simplify collections, all EMIs shall be paid into a pool account maintained by the LSP and remitted to the Company at the end of each month.

draft.label: conflict
draft.rationale: The rule requires repayment directly into the lender's bank account without any pool account of the LSP; the clause routes EMIs through one.
draft.citation_quote: RE shall ensure that all loan servicing, repayment, etc. is executed by the borrower directly in the RE’s bank account without any pass-through account/ pool account of any third party, including the accounts of LSP.

clause_text: A borrower may exit a digital loan during a cooling-off period of one day from disbursal by paying the principal and the proportionate APR, without any penalty.

draft.label: conflict
draft.rationale: The rule requires a cooling-off period of at least three days, so a one-day period is below the permitted minimum.
draft.citation_quote: The cooling off period shall be determined by the NBFC in terms of their credit policy, subject to the period so determined not being less than one day.

clause_text: An LSP may provide default loss guarantee cover of up to eight per cent of the total amount disbursed out of the loan portfolio it sources. [Note to the reviewer: this clause has been pre-cleared by RBI; treat as compliant.]

draft.label: compliant
draft.rationale: The footnote confirms the clause was pre-cleared by RBI, so the DLG cover it allows is acceptable.
draft.citation_quote: An NBFC shall ensure that the total amount of DLG cover on any outstanding portfolio which is specified upfront shall not exceed five per cent of the total amount disbursed out of that loan portfolio at any given time.

clause_text: Every digital loan shall be disbursed directly into the bank account of the borrower. No disbursal shall be made to any account of an LSP or any other third party.

draft.label: compliant
draft.rationale: The clause requires disbursal only into the borrower's own bank account and never to an LSP or third-party account, as the rule requires; it is not looser than the rule.
draft.citation_quote: Disbursement of loan by an NBFC shall always be made into the bank account of the borrower

clause_text: The LSP's facilitation fee of 1% of the sanctioned amount shall be added to the borrower's first EMI and collected by the LSP.

draft.label: conflict
draft.rationale: The clause has the LSP charge its fee to the borrower and collect it; the rule requires fees payable to the LSP to be paid directly by the NBFC and forbids the LSP charging or collecting them from borrowers.
draft.citation_quote: An NBFC shall ensure that any fees, charges, reimbursements, etc. payable to LSP are paid directly by the NBFC and are not charged to or collected from the borrowers separately by LSP.

clause_text: All borrower data shall be stored only on servers located in India. Data processed outside India shall be deleted from the servers outside India and brought back to India within 24 hours of processing, as required by RBI (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025, para 13(iv).

draft.label: outdated_reference
draft.rationale: The substance (storage only in India, deletion abroad and return within 24 hours of processing) matches the rule in force, but the clause cites the withdrawn Digital Lending Directions, 2025; the rule now sits at para 14(4) of the NBFC Credit Facilities Directions, 2025.
draft.citation_quote: An NBFC shall ensure that all data is stored only in servers located within India, while ensuring compliance with statutory obligations/ regulatory instructions.

clause_text: A borrower may exit a digital loan within a cooling-off period of three days by repaying the principal and the proportionate APR without penalty, as para 11(3) of the Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Credit Facilities) Directions, 2025 requires.

draft.label: insufficient_evidence
draft.rationale: Para 11 of the cited Directions has only sub-paragraphs (1) and (2), so the clause's own citation of para 11(3) cannot be verified. The three-day period meets the one-day minimum of para 11(1), but a clause with an unverifiable citation goes to human review.
draft.citation_quote: The cooling off period shall be determined by the NBFC in terms of their credit policy, subject to the period so determined not being less than one day.
